QuestInfo.name: [9th Anniversary Par-tay] Getting Some Beats
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra says a party just isn't a party without music. See if she needs help.
QuestInfo.1: Collect the #i2431716# #b#t2431716##k items, which are shaped like musical notes, from normal monsters. #r1000#k should be enough. Bring them back to Cassandra.
QuestInfo.2: Now you're grooving! Time to boogie on down?

default.0: You still haven't collected all the Muse's Energy?

npc.0: Go talk to Inkie at the 9th Anniversary Park. You can use the Dimensional Mirror or the Teleport Rock that I gave you.
